name: Time blocking
description: Assign blocks for classes, studying, meals, work, exercise, and rest. Include transition time.

name: Pomodoro technique
description: Work in focused intervals with short breaks. Adjust the intervals to fit the task.

name: Eisenhower matrix
description: Sort tasks by urgency and importance so you can prioritize intentionally.

name: Weekly planning
description: Review deadlines and commitments once a week, then break large projects into milestones.

name: Task batching
description: Group similar tasks together to reduce the mental cost of switching activities.
